2610.10526.title: Rephrase Before You Act: Characterizing and Mitigating Language Sensitivity in Vision-Language-Action Models
2610.10526.paper_summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are strikingly sensitive to instruction phrasing and do not inherit the language robustness of the vision-language models they are built on. A one-word edit can move success by tens of points: $π_{0.5}$ turns on a LIBERO stove 100% of the time for "switch on the stove" and 2% for "switch on the hot plate", and a $π_0$ checkpoint finetuned with rephrase augmentation still shows swings of up to 61 points. We characterize this sensitivity with statistically tested single-edit swings and an oracle phrase search, which shows that phrasing alone nearly closes the 21-point gap between in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks. We then reduce it without modifying the policy. Because the sensitivity is systematic, it can be expressed as explicit rules: we score many phrasings of a few training tasks, have a large language model distill the evidence into ten to twenty rephrasing rules, and at deployment rewrite each incoming instruction once under these rules. The rules improve the frozen $π_0$ by 16 to 27% relative on twelve held-out tasks across adversarial, VLM-generated, and human-generated phrasings, with gains concentrated on out-of-distribution tasks. The pipeline replicates on $π_{0.5}$ and LIBERO, lifting in-finetune success from 93.6% to 97.8%. The method requires no retraining and no per-step verification, and applies zero-shot to unseen tasks and instructions. Project website: https://sttawm.github.io/rephrase-before-you-act
2610.10526.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言-行動模型（VLA）對指令措辭極為敏感，並且並未繼承其所基於的視覺-語言模型的語言穩健性。單字的編輯可以使成功率變動數十個百分點：$π_{0.5}$ 在「打開爐子」的情況下100%啟動LIBERO爐具，而在「打開熱板」的情況下僅為2%，而經過重述增強微調的$π_0$檢查點仍顯示出高達61個百分點的波動。我們用統計測試的單一編輯波動和一個神諭短語搜索來表徵這種敏感性，結果顯示僅僅措辭就幾乎縮小了21個百分點的分布內和分布外任務之間的差距。然後，我們在不修改策略的情況下減少了這一差距。由於這種敏感性是系統性的，因此可以表達為明確的規則：我們對幾個訓練任務的多種措辭進行評分，讓一個大型語言模型將證據提煉成十到二十條重述規則，並在部署時根據這些規則對每個進來的指令進行一次重寫。這些規則使得凍結的$π_0$在十二個保留任務中相對提升了16%到27%，涵蓋了對抗性、VLM生成和人類生成的措辭，增益集中在分布外任務上。該流程在$π_{0.5}$和LIBERO上重複，將微調成功率從93.6%提升至97.8%。該方法不需要重新訓練和逐步驗證，並且對未見過的任務和指令進行零樣本應用。項目網站：https://sttawm.github.io/rephrase-before-you-act
